[7:41PM] #LekkiPeninsula #TrafficUpdate 

Smooth flow from Lekki Peninsula to Lekki-Ikoyi Link Bridge roundabout, good movement inw Alexander Avenue, and clear to Admiralty Way.

However, Dome inw Ikate is busy around Itedo, Market, Carwash, and VFS, but outward movement is smooth. No impediments reported.

#FollowLASTMA
